$description: TreeChart (platform/charts/TreeChart.jsx; owner, 2026-10-26, charts-tree-26): a hierarchy drawn by Apache ECharts' tree, left to right or top to bottom, its branches folding. The ECharts theme reads these through the chart's probe classes (echarts/engine.js chartTokens: tree).

tree-chart-link-color.$description: The lines from a node to its children (the chart's axis-line role).

tree-chart-link-width.$description: The lines from a node to its children.

tree-chart-node-color.$description: A node's ring, and the fill of a node whose branch is folded.

tree-chart-node-fill.$description: The inside of an open node or a leaf.

tree-chart-node-radius.$description: A node's radius (an 8px dot on the grid).

tree-chart-focus-color.$description: The ring of the node in keyboard focus.

tree-chart-focus-width.$description: The ring of the node in keyboard focus.

tree-chart-name-focus-font-weight.$description: The name of the node in keyboard focus.

tree-chart-detail-color.$description: The line under a node's name (its role, its count).

tree-chart-detail-font-size.$description: The line under a node's name.

tree-chart-label-gap.$description: Between a node and its label.

tree-chart-leaf-spacing.$description: Left to right: the height each leaf takes (two lines of label and room between).

tree-chart-level-spacing.$description: Top to bottom: the height each level takes.
